Considering body‑contouring after GLP‑1 weight loss?

Significant weight loss with GLP‑1 meds may reveal loose skin on abdomen, arms, thighs, and breasts.
In 2025, 82% of ASPS surgeons reported GLP‑1‑related consultation requests, many about tummy tucks and lifts.
Mexico can reduce travel distance compared with Europe or Asia, making follow‑up easier for US and Canadian patients.

The package covers a Triple Vessel CABG surgery at King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre.

Wonder how Japan’s knee therapies differ?

PRP uses growth factors from your blood to signal the body’s own repair processes.
Stem cell therapy uses live cells from fat or bone marrow to actively regenerate tissue and modulate immunity.
Japan’s Act on the Safety of Regenerative Medicine requires licensed clinics and certified cell‑processing labs.

Read the full guide:
https://www.placidway.com/answer-detail/571066/Comparing-PRP-vs-Stem-Cell-Knee-Treatments-in-Japan-Which-Works-Better
